title: Choose a new name: Stacks is unavailable on the App Store
acceptance: A name chosen and confirmed available in App Store Connect, not merely absent from App Store search
The rename lands before TestFlight, while the CloudKit container still holds only the owner's data
Bundle identifiers, app group, CloudKit container, product name, scheme, directory names and the repo are all updated together
notes: DECIDED 2026-08-25: the app is CAIRN. No published app holds the exact name per the iTunes search API; App Store Connect reservation is stricter and still needs confirming. Chosen because a cairn is literally a stack of stones — continuity with the original name — and exists to mark a path so you can find your way back, which is the product thesis. SCOPE: full rename. Owner confirmed nothing currently saved is important, so the app group and CloudKit container are renamed too rather than kept as legacy strings. That orphans the existing library and any synced records, accepted knowingly. Doing it now is what makes it cheap: after TestFlight it would mean abandoning testers archives or writing a migration.

history.detail: Cairn; user-visible rename only, container identifiers preserved to protect the library
